subject: Security exhibit: staging carveouts, pen-test window, and evidence rhythm
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearspring.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ben.hughes@clearspring.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit: initial redlines and evidence asks

Hi Kimberly / Laura —

Thanks again for walking us through the draft MSA + Order Form yesterday. Attached are a couple of clarifying asks from our security team (Clearspring_Security_Questions_v1.xlsx) and a redline of the exhibit that highlights three high-level concerns: SOC 2 access, penetration testing language, and evidence cadence for operational controls.

Quick summary of our asks:
- SOC 2: We need a mechanism to review the most recent SOC 2 report under NDA and clear timelines for how soon Redwood provides updated reports after issuance.
- Pen test: We request the ability to run a third-party pen test that includes a staging environment with a sampling of production-like traffic; we need guarantees around staging carveouts and ephemeral credentials.
- Evidence cadence: For some assertions we'll expect monthly evidence (config screenshots, logs) and quarterly sample exports for data retention controls.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Provide SOC 2 report access via an NDA link (we provided a sample NDA to procurement).
2) Allow a timeboxed staging carveout for a 48–72 hour pen-test window with ephemeral credentials and a runbook for data handling.
3) Commit to the evidence cadence above or propose an alternative that balances operational overhead and assurance value.

If this looks like it needs legal review, please let us know owners and expected turn times — Clearspring is on a tight procurement schedule for this quarter.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call.

Elena Morales
Senior Security Program Manager
ClearSpring Health

Attachments: Clearspring_Security_Questions_v1.xlsx, ExhibitDraft_Redlines.pdf

-------------------------------------------------------------------

On Wed, Oct 14, 2026 at 11:03 AM kimberly.park@redwood.com wrote:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearspring.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ben.hughes@clearspring.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit: initial redlines and evidence asks

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Laura and I reviewed the spreadsheet and the exhibit PDF. High level notes:

- SOC 2 delivery: we can provide the current SOC 2 report via an NDA link within 2 business days after the signed MSA. We'll add a clause to the exhibit that defines "most recent SOC 2 report" and an SLA for delivery post-signature.
- Pen test / staging: Redwood is open to a timeboxed staging window, but we need to define: notice period (we propose 3 business days), allowed scope (no credential harvesting of live customer keys; ephemeral accounts only), and an ops contact for realtime coordination.
- Evidence cadence: monthly artifacts are heavy for our infra teams. Propose a compromise: monthly operational snapshots for a short canonical set of assertions, and quarterly rolling sample exports for broader controls. We'll document which assertions are in the monthly set.

I'm attaching a quick redline that captures our suggested language edits (redline_markup.docx). If that looks okay, please loop in your procurement/legal and we can push those changes into the order form.

Next steps I propose:
- Karhtik (legal) to confirm the exhibit redlines and any required MSA-level fallback language.
- Laura (assurance) to confirm the monthly assertion list we can commit to.
- Set a 30-minute alignment call: Thu 10/16 10:00 AM PT — does that work for Clearspring?

Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline_markup.docx

-------------------------------------------------------------------

On Thu, Oct 15, 2026 at 09:18 AM karthik.iyer@redwood.com wrote:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: elena.morales@clearspring.com, ben.hughes@clearspring.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit: initial redlines and evidence asks

Thanks all — looping in a few legal clarifications and proposed firm language so Clearspring can see our position. High level legal guidance below (summarized):

1) SOC 2 report access
- Acceptable: provide current SOC 2 report under an NDA, delivered by secure link. Add a definition "Current SOC 2 report" and a delivery SLA of 2 business days after fully executed agreement. We will not accept ongoing continuous access to our security tooling; report delivery is the agreed mechanism.

2) Pen test / staging carveouts
- We will allow a timeboxed pen-test in a staging environment with ephemeral credentials and explicit scope, subject to a 3-business-day notice and mutually agreed runbook.
- Redwood will require that the pen-test does not involve social engineering or attempts to access Redwood production customer data.
- For clarity: Redwood reserves the right to pause/testing if an operational impact is observed; any dispute escalations go to counsel with a 48-hour remediation window.

3) Evidence cadence
- We agree to a hybrid cadence: monthly snapshots limited to a defined minimal set of assertions (list to be produced by Laura by EOD Fri 10/16) + quarterly rolling samples for broader coverage.
- We cannot support unrestricted ad-hoc requests without a commercial amendment; ad-hoc exceptions will be treated as professional-services requests.

4) Order form / MSA fallbacks
- Any modifications to the pen-test allowance that materially increase risk or engineering overhead will be considered an order-form addendum (pricing/ops impact). Please surface those items ASAP.

Action items and owners:
- Laura: publish the monthly-assertion list and the minimal artifact spec (screenshots, log slices) by 2026-10-16 EOD.
- Kimberly: final redline to Elena + DocuSign-ready MSA exhibit by 2026-10-16 noon PT.
- Clearspring: confirm acceptability of 3-business-day notice + 48–72h execution window and provide preferred dates for testing.

If Clearspring confirms, legal can finalize the exhibit language and we can include a short clause in the order form describing operational carveouts and cost impact if the pen-test requires dedicated staging capacity.

Thanks — Karthik
General Counsel (acting)
Redwood Inference

-------------------------------------------------------------------

On Fri, Oct 16, 2026 at 16:29:00 -0700 Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearspring.com> wrote:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearspring.com>

Cc: ben.hughes@clearspring.com
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 16:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit: initial redlines and evidence asks

Thanks — that all reads reasonable and appreciated. A few quick confirmations: 
- Clearspring accepts SOC 2 via NDA link and the 2-business-day SLA. Procurement will return an executed NDA by EOD Mon 10/19 if you can hold the link.
- The proposed pen-test model is OK with our security team: 3-business-day notice and ephemeral creds are acceptable. We prefer a 72-hour execution window (rather than 48 hours) if possible; can Redwood confirm?
- Laura, can you send the monthly assertion list today so we can validate.

Proposed test dates: Tue 11/16 — we need to confirm internal scheduling but that range works for the team.

Please send the DocuSign-ready exhibit and I'll route the procurement/ legal next steps.

Elena Morales
Senior Security Program Manager
ClearSpring Health

Attachments referenced: Clearspring_Security_Questions_v1.xlsx, ExhibitDraft_Redlines.pdf, redline_markup.docx
